name: Chiodos
label: Equal Vision Records
lede: Six kids from Davison, Michigan named their band after the effects brothers behind Killer Klowns from Outer Space, sold more than 39,000 copies of one album in a week, fired their singer, took him back, and ended up arguing over who gets to play the old songs.

eras.title: The Chiodos Bros of Davison
eras.text: A high school band from Davison, Michigan took its name from the effects brothers behind Killer Klowns from Outer Space and grew up on the stage of Flint's all-ages Local 432. Three self-made EPs later, Equal Vision Records came calling.

years.h: Six high schoolers in Davison, Michigan start the Chiodos Bros
years.p: [[Craig Owens|2e25954c-2b81-43fe-9f83-eeadff769fd3]], Bradley Bell, Pat McManaman, Jason Hale, Matt Goddard and Derrick Frost play all-ages shows at Flint Local 432, a club downtown.
years.xp:
The name honored Stephen, Charles and Edward Chiodo, the effects trio who made Killer Klowns from Outer Space, as Spin explained in 2011.

They were the Chiodos Bros through three EPs between 2001 and 2003, then shortened it to Chiodos.

years.h: A first demo in June, still billed as the Chiodos Bros
years.p: The band cuts the tape in June 2002. EPs follow through 2003, and the name shrinks to Chiodos.

years.h: Equal Vision Records signs Chiodos
years.p: After years of touring and self-released EPs, the band lands on a label that also has [[Coheed and Cambria|ae1b47d5-5128-431c-9d30-e08fd90e0767]] and, soon, [[Circa Survive|a2496a3c-8f42-4b98-b780-6f8d64f56441]].

eras.title: Titles that read like inside jokes
eras.text: Chiodos wrote songs with titles that sounded like punchlines, and Warped Tour kids learned every one. By 2007 an Equal Vision band was debuting in the Billboard top five.

years.src: Wikipedia: All's Well That Ends Well
yt: Baby, You Wouldn't Last a Minute on the Creek
years.h: Chiodos make their debut with All's Well That Ends Well
years.p: Recorded in February 2005 at Audiolux in Elmore, Ohio, with producer Marc Hudson. It reaches No. 3 on Top Heatseekers and sells more than 200,000 copies by 2008.
years.xp:
The titles did half the work: There's No Penguins in Alaska, No Hardcore Dancing in the Living Room, Who's Sandie Jenkins. Wikipedia says To Trixie and Reptile, Thanks for Everything refers to old girlfriends of Craig Owens and Bradley Bell.

The album peaked at No. 164 on the Billboard 200. Four videos came from it, including The Words "Best Friend" Become Redefined.
play: Baby, You Wouldn't Last a Minute on the Creek

years.h: A year of opening slots, ending with Atreyu in the fall
years.p: Armor for Sleep's AP tour, the Take Action tour with [[Matchbook Romance|71bd1152-5ee2-4919-80d7-d269dfd48a55]], Warped Tour, then [[Atreyu|17e137fb-59e5-4fd7-af48-afc34995396c]]'s World Championship Tour.

years.h: Owens takes a second name, the Ram, in a masked band
years.p: Owens joins [[The Sound of Animals Fighting|9f492774-4cdb-4735-b299-5b6affafe4d4]], the masked, rotating supergroup, and sings as the Ram.

yt: The Undertaker's Thirst for Revenge Is Unquenchable
years.h: Bone Palace Ballet lands at No. 5 on the Billboard 200
years.p: Chiodos' second album sells more than 39,000 copies in its first week and tops the Independent Albums chart. It passes 200,000 in the US by January 2009.
years.xp:
Casey Bates produced it at Saint Claire Recording Company in Lexington, Kentucky. The title comes from a Charles Bukowski poetry collection; song titles nod to Slaughterhouse-Five, Harry Potter, Wayne's World and Trailer Park Boys.

The singles were Lexington (Joey Pea-Pot with a Monkey Face) and The Undertaker's Thirst for Revenge Is Unquenchable (The Final Battle).

eras.title: Arenas, then the axe
eras.text: Chiodos opened arenas for Linkin Park, then flew to Australia to share bills with Nine Inch Nails. Behind the scenes Craig Owens and the rest were not getting along, and in September 2009 the band fired him.

years.h: Flint's all-ages club to Linkin Park's arena tour
years.p: Chiodos open for [[Linkin Park|f59c5520-5f46-4d2c-b2c4-822eabf53419]] in early 2008, with [[Coheed and Cambria|ae1b47d5-5128-431c-9d30-e08fd90e0767]] on the same bill.

years.cap: Owens with Chiodos, Columbus, Ohio, September 23, 2008
years.h: Owens and Bell start a lighter side band, Cinematic Sunrise
years.p: Craig Owens and Bradley Bell make Cinematic Sunrise away from Chiodos.

years.h: Trailer Park Boys turn up on the Bone Palace Ballet reissue
years.p: Grand Coda adds five bonus tracks and a DVD with the Trailer Park Boys cast at a Chiodos show at Madison Square Garden.

years.h: A Michigan band plays Australia with Nine Inch Nails
years.p: Chiodos share bills with [[Nine Inch Nails|b7ffd2af-418f-4be2-bdd1-22f8b48613da]] and [[Alice in Chains|4bd95eea-b9f6-4d70-a36c-cfea77431553]]. In March they cover Harvey Danger's Flagpole Sitta for Punk Goes Pop Volume 2.

years.cap: Chiodos at Warped Tour, Boston, July 2009
years.h: Warped Tour's main stage, one last summer with Owens
years.p: Chiodos share the 2009 main stage with [[The Devil Wears Prada|43c0958c-27ef-46c4-b4cc-83cfca54170d]], [[Bad Religion|149e6720-4e4a-41a4-afca-6d29083fc091]], [[Silverstein|d89de379-665d-425c-b2e9-41b95d1edb36]], [[Saosin|47b8b42a-96e8-46fa-9ea6-70c5136ae971]] and [[Underoath|674a7e8c-9682-419a-8e05-2358e28b5359]].

q: This decision was a necessary one.
years.h: Chiodos let Craig Owens go and won't say why
years.p: The band announces it on September 24, 2009 and declines to explain. Drummer Derrick Frost leaves at the same time.
years.xp:
The statement ran on MySpace. The band said they would not discuss reasons out of respect for their years together, wished Owens well and promised to carry on.

Wikipedia describes tension and acrimony between Owens and the others before the split. A demo called Thermacare, recorded with Owens that month, leaked in June 2010; his new band D.R.U.G.S. released its own version as The Only Thing You Talk About.

eras.title: The Bolmer detour
eras.text: Chiodos carried on with a new singer and a new drummer and made one album with them. Two and a half years later both were gone, and Owens and Derrick Frost were back.

years.h: A singer from Yesterdays Rising takes the mic
years.p: Alternative Press reports that Brandon Bolmer will front Chiodos. Tanner Wayne of Underminded takes over the drums.

years.h: Illuminaudio is the only album with Bolmer
years.p: Machine produces it in Weehawken and Hoboken, New Jersey. It debuts at No. 37, with [[Vic Fuentes|b6c39311-3af7-40f9-bd57-69b089c7720d]] of [[Pierce the Veil|8ed919fb-eaee-45a1-ba99-b3ede9ca5f1d]] guesting on Love Is a Cat from Hell.
years.xp: By March 2014 it had sold 49,000 copies in the US. It was also Hale's last album with the band. The Owens-era demo Thermacare was reworked here as Stratovolcano Mouth.
play: Love Is a Cat from Hell

years.h: Bolmer and Wayne are out after one album
years.p: The announcement comes on March 27, 2012, two years after they joined.

years.cap: Owens at Warped Tour, Boston, July 2009
years.h: Owens is back, and the first show is where it started
years.p: Owens and Frost rejoin, announced by video on April 26, 2012. The first show back is August 9, 2012 at Flint Local 432, the club where Chiodos began.

eras.title: Devil, and done
eras.text: The reunited band added Thomas Erak of The Fall of Troy and made Devil, a top-15 album. Then the original members started peeling off, and in 2016 Owens said it was over.

years.h: The Fall of Troy's Thomas Erak replaces Jason Hale
years.p: Original guitarist Hale is gone, and Chiodos welcome [[Thomas Erak|ee06d27b-a6e8-47be-aa65-071952cc38e4]] of [[The Fall of Troy|8d3ee4ba-be21-470c-bb7c-4c124c3eb989]] in January 2013.

years.h: Devil arrives on Razor & Tie and debuts at No. 12
years.p: Made in Woodstock, New York with [[David Bottrill|1f2f08f6-487d-4bcc-8f9b-41c170b2464f]], it sells more than 18,000 copies its first week. Owens said the title is about everyday temptations, not the supernatural.

years.h: Two founders leave, and a former Mars Volta drummer arrives
years.p: Frost and founding bassist Matt Goddard leave Chiodos. [[Thomas Pridgen|80a494e5-a517-4f1e-a914-b0638232edf1]], formerly of [[The Mars Volta|20883363-1ea4-4d72-ad72-c0e767038f3e]], takes the drums and Joseph Troy the bass.
years.xp: Wikipedia lists Troy as coming from Rx Bandits.

years.h: Erak leaves after two years
years.p: Thomas Erak departs on December 9, 2014 to focus on The Fall of Troy.

years.big: "It just stopped becoming a passion for most of us"
q: It just stopped becoming a passion for most of us
years.h: Owens tells Billboard that Chiodos are done
years.p: The band couldn't keep going full-time, he says, in the interview of November 1, 2016.
years.xp: Billboard's Gary Graff got the news in an interview about Owens' solo project, badXchannels.

eras.title: Chiodos without the Chiodos Bros
eras.text: Craig Owens brought the name back with musicians from D.R.U.G.S. and Frail Body, and without the people he started it with. Bradley Bell said the other original members were never told.

years.h: Chiodos join the When We Were Young bill, and the originals weren't told
years.p: Chiodos are billed for When We Were Young 2024 in Las Vegas. Bradley Bell says the other original members were never informed of Owens' reunion plans.

years.h: Chiodos play Las Vegas with one original member
years.p: The first Chiodos show in years, at When We Were Young on October 19, 2024, has Owens as the only original member. Weeks later they announce an All's Well That Ends Well 20th anniversary tour with [[Hawthorne Heights|194eeda1-e662-43bc-b9be-32fc1afecc8b]] and Emmure.

years.h: Chiodos sail on the Emo's Not Dead cruise
years.p: The reformed band plays the cruise, then Warped Tour dates and Louder Than Life.

years.h: A re-recorded All's Well arrives with five of six originals missing
years.p: SharpTone releases a 20th anniversary version of All's Well That Ends Well. Bell calls it out and tells fans to play the original.
years.xp: On Facebook, Bell wrote that the songs had been written in bedrooms, basements and short buses and meant a lot to the band, and that the original deserved to be preserved, per Lambgoat.

years.h: Chiodos sign to SharpTone and release Tapdat
years.p: It's the band's first new music since 2014. The It's Not You, It's Me tour starts July 30, and a new album is due to be recorded after it.

years.h: Louder Than Life books Chiodos alongside Circa Survive
years.p: Chiodos are on the Louder Than Life 2026 bill in Louisville, the same festival [[Circa Survive|a2496a3c-8f42-4b98-b780-6f8d64f56441]] chose for their comeback.
